# docker_registry_image_tags (Data Source)

Lists every tag of a repository straight from its registry (`GET /v2/<name>/tags/list`), following pagination, with the provider's `registry_auth`. Tags come back in the registry's order, which for distribution-based registries is lexical.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_registry_image_tags" "app" {
  name      = "ghcr.io/org/app"
  page_size = 500
}

# Newest release tag by name, e.g. "v1.12.0".
output "latest_release" {
  value = reverse(sort([for t in data.docker_registry_image_tags.app.tags : t if startswith(t, "v")]))[0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Repository, e.g. `nginx`, `ghcr.io/org/app` or `localhost:5000/app`. A tag or digest in it is ignored.

### Optional

- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification of the registry.
- `page_size` (Number) Tags requested per page (`n`). Default: the registry's own page size.

### Read-Only

- `repository` (String) Normalized `registry/repository`, e.g. `docker.io/library/nginx`.
- `tags` (List of String) The tags.
